media_item.focus_or_theme: Update on the Norfolk Four case, false confessions
media_item.summary_notes: While specific production details for a "Revisited" episode weren't found, extensive information confirms the significant developments in the Norfolk Four case after the original documentary, culminating in full pardons in 2017. A "Revisited" episode would likely cover these events. FRONTLINE did feature the case again in 2013.

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Rape and Murder of Michelle Moore-Bosko (1997)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Convicted of rape and murder in 1997 based on a coerced false confession. Received a conditional pardon in 2009, conviction vacated later, and a full pardon in 2017. Served significant prison time.
contributing_factors_raw: Ignoring exculpatory DNA pointing to actual perpetrator Omar Ballard
